newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Country Heights to sell land to Sunrise.
newsitem.headline: Country Heights to sell land to Sunrise.

text.p: Malaysian property firm Country Heights Holdings Bhd said on Monday it has signed an agreement to sell 478.6 acres of freehold land to Sunrise Bhd for 167 million ringgit.
The agreement by its wholly-owned unit, Perkara Bagus Sdn Bhd, will realise "huge exceptional gains" for Country Heights, the company said in a statement.
Perkara Bagus bought the mixed development land in southern Negeri Sembilan state for 9.2 million ringgit in 1990.
The proposed disposal will add 147 million ringgit to the "exceptional gain" of Country Heights.
It will also improve the company's gross earnings per share by 97.7 cents for the year ending February 28, 1998, the statement said.
